t: A teacher dashboard for assigning GeoGebra math activities and watching progress live.
steps: Open GeoGebra Classroom in a web browser.
Build an activity or pick one from the library.
Create a class and copy the join code.
Review the privacy policy with your school before students join.
Use the option to hide names the first time you show responses.
Watch the Learn how to use GeoGebra Classroom lessons.
